meta.method: Scores were read automatically from the text of the official WHO JEE report PDFs listed in the WHO SPH document library (read in memory, not stored). A score is the number printed after each indicator title ("Score N"); the page is the PDF page number. Edition was assigned from the indicator set found in each report, not from the publication year. Reports with fewer than 28 indicator scores extracted were left out. Only one third-edition report (Samoa 2023) is openly downloadable from the WHO library so far; other recent reports (Benin, Sierra Leone, Nepal, Azerbaijan) have library pages without a file.
